summary: E2E validation on preview (390x844) of the ALERTA SONORO DE NOVA ENTREGA feature in /deliverer + regression. 29/30 assertions passed. Sound-alert observable behavior is fully working: d-enable-sound -> d-sound-active toggle, localStorage persistence (off360_deliverer_sound=1), persistence across d-tab-{active,links,new}, banner/badge/offer-count/scope='Entrega externa'/accept/reject buttons on independent deliverer, d-stop-sound appears WHILE playing and disappears after click (banner + card remain unaffected), Reject removes card only for that deliverer, Accept moves order to d-list-active with d-start-<id> and removes it from d-list-new. Audio actually initialized in headless Chromium (AudioContext resumed successfully; playing=true) so d-stop-sound WAS observable. No JS pageerror thrown; only harmless 401s from /auth/me during logout transitions.

integration_issues.issue: Deliverer D1 with an APPROVED (status=active) link to the merchant still received the offer created with offer_scope='external' (saw d-new-offer-banner + d-order-<id> with scope 'Entrega externa'). The review spec explicitly states: 'entrega elegível (para entregador vinculado com offer_scope=own OU independente com offer_scope=external)'. So D1 (vinculado ativo) should NOT be elegible for external offers. Root cause is likely in the backend eligibility query at /deliverer/orders/available (routes_delivery.py) — the external filter is probably not excluding deliverers who already have an active link to the establishment.

action_items: Fix eligibility rule for offer_scope='external' in routes_delivery.py: exclude deliverers that already have an active link with the merchant (they should only receive scope='own' offers). Alternative: if by design the vinculado also sees external offers as a fallback pool, update the review-request spec/text to reflect this and clarify UX (currently the badge shown says 'Entrega externa' which is confusing to a vinculado).
Cleanup no banco (preview): remover as contas e o estabelecimento QASND (ver seed_data_creation).
critical_code_review_comments: Deliverer.js:75 useEffect depends on 'offerIds.join(",")' — works, but the eslint-disable comment hides the fact that offerIds is recreated every render. Consider useMemo(() => offers.map(o => o.id).join(','), [offers]) to avoid noisy re-renders.

Deliverer.js:54 stopSound() replaces mutedIdsRef with a NEW Set(offerIds). If a new offer arrives between fetches, it is NOT in mutedIdsRef and the sound will restart (correct). But if the user pressed 'Parar som' and then a second offer arrives in the SAME poll cycle, they will both be added to mutedIdsRef only for the current snapshot; a following different offer will re-trigger the alarm — intended behavior per spec, just worth documenting.

deliveryAlert.js: no listener for ctx.onstatechange, so if the browser auto-suspends the AudioContext (tab hidden > some seconds) 'playing' state on the React side stays true while no beeps are actually produced. Consider watching ctx.state and updating soundOn/playing accordingly.

Deliverer.js: no dedicated data-testid on the toast for '409 já foi aceita por outro entregador' — the 409 case couldn't be exercised in a single-browser session, but it would be easier to test with an id like 'd-toast-conflict'.
Registration form for merchant does NOT auto-create the 1st estabelecimento (already flagged in iteration_27). Still valid feedback.

rca of the issue: D1 (vinculado ativo) seeing 'Entrega externa' offer suggests /deliverer/orders/available for offer_scope='external' is returning orders to ALL deliverers regardless of their active links. Reproduction: 1) Create merchant + est with offers_delivery=true; 2) Register D1, request link, merchant approves (m-link-approve-<id>) so link status = active; 3) Merchant creates order with m-new-scope-external; 4) D1 logs in — UNEXPECTED: D1 sees banner + d-order-<id> with d-scope-<id>='Entrega externa'. Expected: D1 should NOT see it (spec: vinculado sees only 'own'). Mitigation: In routes_delivery.py, filter external-scope offers to only include deliverers WITHOUT an active establishment link (or without an active link to that specific merchant if the product decides vinculado-to-other-store should still be pooled as independente for external offers).
